briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 push AGI timelines forward as compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid surging investment. Regulatory scrutiny grows while vulnerabilities persist across deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with extended reasoning; xAI releases Grok-4; DeepSeek-V4 and Anthropic Claude 4.1 compete on benchmarks. Meta open-sources Llama 4 while Google DeepMind advances Gemini 3.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins with new red-team mandates.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 2M units; Microsoft and Google announce 50GW data center expansions; TSMC 2nm yields improve for custom AI chips.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards like dynamic dialects prevent the next wave of autonomous AI failures before 2028?
